decisions.reason: After another year on the market, this camera remains close to the core business and the earlier public launch and invested development effort make management unlikely to reverse course.
The modular camera line strongly matches the firm's stated move toward compact and flexible sensors, and having several models deepens commitment to continue rather than withdraw.
This sensor suite builds on established capabilities and future-oriented space operations, so any uneven commercial uptake is likely to be treated as temporary in a growing R&D-driven market.
As a newly launched radiation-hard camera line with its own page and several models, it sits squarely in the firm's technical core and visible commitment supports persistence.

Although the asteroid navigation and imaging camera appears more niche and was presented less prominently, it still extends announced strategic capabilities and management is likely to give it more time before abandoning it.
